sun.label: Sun
sun.purpose: Identity, direction, and what feels meaningful to build over time.

opening: Your Sun describes the part of you that wants direction: the values you stand for, the kind of progress that feels meaningful, and the identity you grow into through choice and effort.

When this layer is resourced, you tend to act with clarity and self-respect. When it is chronically blocked, people often drift into approval-seeking, overworking for recognition, or choosing roles that look right but quietly drain them.
anchors: Think of the Sun as your long-range compass: it points to what you want to build when you are not simply reacting to the day.
It is less about “who you should be” and more about what kind of direction makes you feel internally aligned.
integrationCue: A strong Sun path does not remove difficulty. It makes difficulty feel worth it because the effort serves something you can respect.

moon.label: Moon
moon.purpose: Emotional needs, regulation patterns, and how you return to baseline after stress.

opening: Your Moon describes emotional needs and regulation: what steadies you, what you do automatically under pressure, and what restores you when life gets loud.
This is not a mood label. It is a practical nervous-system lens: when you know your Moon pattern, you can notice stress earlier and create choice instead of running on autopilot.
anchors: Under strain, many people default to a familiar loop (escalate, withdraw, overexplain, control). The Moon helps you name your loop without judging it.
Regulation is not suppression. It is the ability to stay connected to yourself while responding wisely.
integrationCue: When your Moon needs are ignored for too long, even strong strengths begin to fray. Supporting this layer protects everything else.

asc.label: Ascendant
asc.purpose: First-contact style: how you enter situations, start interactions, and how others initially read you.

opening: Your Ascendant describes your default starting strategy: how you enter new situations before you have time to overthink, and what kind of first impression your presence tends to create.
It is not a fake mask. It is a functional pattern shaped by temperament and experience — the way you begin when you’re not consciously editing yourself.
anchors: The Ascendant is most visible at transitions: new rooms, new people, new roles, new pressure.
Growth here is flexibility: choosing your entry style intentionally rather than running it on autopilot.
integrationCue: When your Ascendant is aligned with your Sun direction and Moon needs, you feel coherent. When it isn’t, you may feel misunderstood or performative without knowing why.
